name: brine-theme
description: Dark monochrome theme for the Pterodactyl Panel user area - #0b0b0d page, #141417 surfaces, #c8ccd0 neutral accent, fixed sidebar shell, redesigned dashboard, login, console and file manager. Admin area, favicon and page title untouched.

files.note: Dropdown positioning and surface. The stock panel rendered `absolute` inside a plain wrapper and nudged it with `left = viewportX - width`, which is only correct when the wrapper sits at the viewport origin - inside a .file_row it was pushed off to the right, and the row clipped it, so the per-file actions never appeared. Now `position: fixed` with the vertical placement taken from the toggle rect and clamped to the viewport, repositioned on scroll/resize. Surface uses the theme tokens instead of bg-white. Same props, named export and triggerMenu ref API as stock

Stock Field plus an optional labelAction rendered on the label row beside the label. The stock component puts the label on its own line with the input after it, so a "Forgot password?" link had to live in a separate block below the field; the reference puts it beside the label, which needs the label row to be a flex container and cannot be done from the stylesheet because the link is not a sibling of the label. Additive - with no labelAction the markup is byte-for-byte stock, so the other ~200 call sites in the panel are untouched

Per-file actions panel. The stock rows hovered to bg-neutral-100 on text-neutral-700, which on the black palette is a near-white bar with near-black text across a dark menu; rows are now tinted to the palette so hover brightens by one step and Delete reads as destructive without turning white. Toggle matches the file-row hover and names the file for screen readers. Same behaviour as stock, including the pterodactyl:files:ctx right-click event

Emits every colour utility as rgb(var(--pt-*)) on Tailwind 3.1+ and as baked-in hex on 2.1/3.0, which cannot apply an opacity modifier to a CSS variable; adds navy/gold brand ramps and aliases blue/primary to navy and cyan to gold. The literal PALETTE here is the pre-3.1 fallback and is kept byte-for-byte in step with the --pt-* blocks in pterodactyl-theme.css - drift between the two makes a rebuild look like the stylesheet did not apply

Stock head (title, csrf, robots) + the theme favicon only, plus data-pt-theme on <html> and a theme-color that follows the chosen palette - both server-rendered so a variant never shows the default for a frame. The stylesheet is cache-busted on its own mtime: config(app.version) is the panel version, so it never changes on a theme update and browsers kept the previous stylesheet for the max-age the server sends. The favicon picks the newest custom-logo.* and appends its mtime, and the icon MIME type comes from the extension rather than being hardcoded to image/png
ptColor() helper for Chart.js - dark-only, no theme state

The server routes the theme adds on top of the panel routes.server table - Plugins and Mods - in one place so the router, the sidebar and the topbar title cannot drift apart. Each carries a jarKind that gates its nav item

brandName()/logoUrl()/registrationEnabled()/backgroundStyle()/quickLinks()/linkHref() - site name, icon (pasted link wins over the uploaded file), registration switch, the two background slots and the Home/Discord/Status links from window.SiteConfiguration

Monochrome black tokens (#0b0b0d page, #141417 surface, #c8ccd0 neutral accent, system fonts), a fixed neutral aurora field behind every screen, frosted glass on the sidebar/topbar/drawer/auth card and tinted glass on the cards, admin-set background image layers with an adjustable black scrim over the auth screens and the dashboard, auth breadcrumb + quick-link buttons, the round small loading ring, and a [data-pt-theme] block for the amber palette - the default black palette is the :root block itself. Owns focus rings for every theme control (none on :focus, a gold ring on :focus-visible). The neutral ramp is split at 500/600 - 50-500 text, 600-900 surface. The auth screens are a 50/50 split: .pt-auth-hero owns the admin auth image with a two-stop vertical scrim so the marketing line at its foot stays legible, .pt-auth-panel owns the vertical rule and the centring. The responsive overrides are declared after every base rule on purpose - a media query adds no specificity, so declaring one first lets the base rule overwrite it
Brand mark used by the sidebar and the login screen

Admin-configured Home/Discord/Status links: <AuthLinks> row above the auth card, <TopbarLinkCluster> centred pills in the dashboard topbar. Discord is the real brand mark, inlined as SVG because the panel does not ship free-brands-svg-icons

Fixed sidebar + sticky topbar + mobile drawer shell for dashboard and server routes, applies the dashboard background image; sign-out lives in the sidebar since the topbar no longer has it. Resolves the topbar title for the theme own server routes (lib/serverExtras) and passes the server uuid and egg variables down so the sidebar can pick the jar nav items

Aternos-style sidebar with brand block (site icon shown with no chip or background, falling back to the first letter), permission-filtered server/account navigation, sign-out button and user footer. Renders the theme jar routes, showing Plugins when the server has plugins/ and Mods when it has mods/ - a hybrid gets both
Three-column topbar (1fr auto 1fr): burger + title, the centred Home/Discord/Status pill cluster, and a balancing spacer - search, admin, avatar, sign-out and the old dashboard shortcut removed
Wraps the dashboard in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation

Wraps server routes in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation, and mounts the theme own server routes (Plugins and Mods) after the panel table so a stock route of the same path would win rather than be shadowed
Auth routes: centres the login card, adds /auth/register, applies the auth background image, and owns the Home / Login breadcrumb pinned to the page top-left

The split-screen auth shell shared by every auth screen: a hero half carrying the admin background image and the two-tone marketing line, and a form panel carrying the brand lockup, the card and the optional subuser hint. The hero and panel are siblings, not nested, because the rule between them is a border on the panel and the hero has to bleed to the viewport edge. Carries the hero copy as fixed constants - it is the theme marketing line, not a panel setting - while the site name comes from brandName() on the lockup

Login form + success flash after registration (?registered=1). Copy matches the reference ("Welcome back" / "Log in to manage your game server", "Log in"), except the field stays "Username or Email" because the endpoint accepts either. The "Forgot password?" link moved onto the Password label row via Field labelAction, and the subuser hint is enabled here
Public registration form (email, first/last name, username, password, confirm) posting to /auth/register
CSRF + POST /auth/register client
Same treatment for the 2FA checkpoint screen
Same treatment for the password recovery screen
Same treatment for the password recovery screen, including the same corrected muted-link hover direction
Branded hero header, section title and empty state
Server cards with status/allocation chips, CPU/MEM/DISK stat blocks and colour bars
Adds the shared footer: Powered by the panel's own site name via brandName(), plus a Design copyright brineajay credit line

Dialog surface painted by the .pt-modal class instead of a twin.macro bg-neutral-800. A colour inside a twin.macro css prop is inlined at build time, and below Tailwind 3.1 this config bakes literal hex, which pinned every dialog to the default violet on the black/amber palettes. Same props, exports and portal as stock

Replaces the stock loading ring: caps every size at 22px (stock large was 64px with m-20 of dead margin) and re-asserts border-radius 50% with !important, which the theme's universal `* { border-radius: 0 !important; }` square-corner reset otherwise flattened into a box. Ring colour follows --pt-gold-500
Sharp 3px buttons with uppercase letter-spaced labels
Branded console header with status chip and gold call-to-action power button
Marks the Start button for the gold call-to-action treatment

Terminal chrome: window bar, dots, title and command hint, plus a ResizeObserver on the terminal host so the FitAddon re-fits when the box changes width without a window resize - the mobile drawer opening, or the browser URL bar collapsing

Navy-black terminal, neutral stat cards and gold accents. The mobile full-bleed hack (-ml-4 with width: calc(100% + 2rem)) is gone: it made xterm measure a box 2rem wider than the visible area, so the right end of every line was clipped. Edge-to-edge is kept by zeroing the container padding on phones instead, which does not lie to the measurer
Console detail stat blocks re-skinned to neutral cards with gold icons
Resolves chart palette through ptColor()
Resolves chart grid/tick/line colours through ptColor()
Toolbar layout and branded empty state
Navy path bar with gold links and monospaced type
Card-style file rows with icon tiles, size and modified columns

File manager row, tile, empty-state and mass-action styles. The row deliberately does not set overflow: hidden - it has a square corner radius so nothing needs clipping, and clipping was swallowing the per-row dropdown anchored to it
Branded selection bar with selection counter

Admin -> Site Settings: site name, icon (uploaded file or pasted link), the two background slots (auth/dashboard - upload or pasted link, each with an on/off switch, its own Save button and a black overlay intensity slider), the panel palette picker (default/black/amber) and the Home/Discord/Status quick links. Uploads are capped to what this server can actually accept: php.ini upload_max_filesize/post_max_size are read and the lower of those and the theme cap is what the page advertises, and a file PHP discarded is reported with the reason from the upload error code instead of being treated as "no file chosen". Uploads are stored under a fixed stem with a per-upload extension, so replacing one deletes EVERY match (deleteStem) rather than the first glob hit, and each read picks the newest file rather than whatever order the filesystem returned - otherwise one failed delete left a stale file that won the next glob and came back on screen. The post-upload check tests the exact filename just written

Responsive Site Settings page with server-rendered tabs (no tab JS): General (name + icon with preview, then a separate Login & register and Dashboard background block, each with upload/link, on-off switch, intensity slider, live preview and its own Save), Theme (palette cards with colour swatches, validated server-side against a whitelist) and Links (Home/Discord/Status, each with a switch and URL). Upload help text shows the server-derived ceiling rather than the theme cap, so it cannot promise a size PHP will drop. Preview script is vanilla and inlined at the end of @section('content') so it cannot replace the layout's footer-scripts block
POST /auth/register - creates the account directly with the panel's own UserCreationService (hashed password, welcome e-mail, no API key)
Admin -> Registration: enable/disable public sign-up
Registration settings page with the enable switch

Exposes SiteConfiguration.logo / .registration.enabled / .backgrounds / .overlay / .links / .theme.variant; validates link targets and the palette slug server-side against a whitelist; reports recaptcha as disabled so the widget never renders and the exhausted-quota lockout cannot happen. Uploaded images are resolved newest-first and carry their mtime as a ?v= cache-buster - a URL that does not change when the file does is one the browser will not refetch, which is why replacing the favicon used to leave the previous image on screen
Stock auth routes + GET/POST /auth/register, throttled; drops the stock recaptcha middleware, which would reject every login with HTTP 400 once the shared public keys exhaust their quota
Stock routes + /admin/site-settings + /admin/registration + GET/POST /admin/servers/view/{server}/software
Stock admin layout + Site Settings and Registration menu items. Favicon handling is kept identical to templates/wrapper.blade.php: newest match wins, mtime cache-buster, MIME type from the extension

Jar installer API, shared by both flavours. Modrinth catalog (search + versions) called straight from the browser - api.modrinth.com sends access-control-allow-origin: *, and Spigot/Hangar do not, so supporting them would mean the panel proxying arbitrary URLs. Installs go through the panel own POST files/pull, which hands the URL to the daemon, so the jar never passes through the browser and needs no new route or permission. JAR_KINDS holds the per-flavour directory, Modrinth project_type and loaders

Classifies a server from its egg variables. The egg name is not exposed to the client - ServerController::index never calls parseIncludes() and egg_features is identical across the Minecraft eggs - but EggVariableTransformer throws on anything not user_viewable, so the variable NAMES that reach the browser are a reliable family fingerprint. Also decides which jar flavours are worth probing

The Plugins and Mods page - one component, parameterised by JarKind, since installing a Bukkit plugin and a Forge mod are the same operation with a different directory, project type and loaders. Installed list with remove, Modrinth search with a version picker, install, live search, 20-per-page pager, and a warning when a version declares required dependencies. Installing needs file.create, removing file.delete, opening the page file.read
Plugins and Mods page styling on the theme tokens - square corners, gray-700 surfaces, 400 for hairlines and 300 for text, since 600 is the muted fill step and 700+ are surfaces

The software (egg) switch, which this panel has had removed entirely - updateBuild takes only allocations and limits, BuildModificationService handles no egg_id or image, and the admin build view never mentions an egg, so this is written from scratch. Two schema differences from stock Pterodactyl matter: the column is eggs.startup not eggs.start, and there is no eggs.docker_image - this is a Blueprint panel with a docker_images map of {label: image}, so resolveImage keeps the server on the Java version it already has. Rebuilds server_variables from the target egg, carrying values across wherever env_variable exists on both. Refuses while the server is live, reading the power state from the daemon because servers.status never records running

Admin -> Servers -> View -> Software. Root-admin only, but by the panel own gate rather than a check of ours: the routes live in routes/admin.php, which the panel loads inside AdminAuthenticate, and that throws unless root_admin is set. Lists the panel own eggs grouped by nest - no hardcoded list, so imported eggs such as Spigot, Velocity or Fabric appear once an admin adds them

The Software page. Same-family targets (Paper/Spigot/Purpur) and cross-family ones (anything that needs a reinstall) are in separate columns so it is obvious which is which before submitting. Works without JavaScript - the wipe confirmation is enforced server-side - and the script only adds a live summary and the enable/disable

The server-view tab bar, with a Software tab added between Startup and Database. A copy of the panel partial plus that one entry, because the tab bar is shared by every server sub-page and the theme already replaces other shared panel files
